source: Real Gavelling UI on localhost:3000 (Schibsted Grotesk), throwaway standalone room, since deleted

clips.alt: Gavelling chair console during the General Speakers' List: Kenya holds the floor with 1:02 on a running clock, the upcoming speakers as round flags across the top, and the speakers list in the sidebar.
clips.shows: Chair page (/chair/CODE), desktop 1440x900 at DPR 2. GSL with a seated speaker, running clock, speaker strip, sidebar queue with quorum tabs, Pause / Next / add time / right of reply controls. Paper-grain overlay hidden to keep the PNG small.

clips.alt: Gavelling Motions dialog ranking four motions on the floor: a Tour de Table from Ghana, an unmoderated caucus from Brazil and moderated caucuses from France and Japan.
clips.shows: Chair page with the Motions dialog open (cropped to the dialog): motions ranked by disruptiveness, the motion being voted on with Accept / Reject / Edit, the 2/3 majority requirement, the queue column and Raise a Motion.

clips.alt: Gavelling voting screen mid-ballot on draft resolution DR 1/1: Indonesia is voting, previous delegations recede to the left with their votes, and the running tally reads 5 for, 1 against.
clips.shows: Voting page (/voting/CODE), desktop 1440x900 at DPR 2: roll-call ballot with the voter carousel, the six ballot choices, Back, the live tally bar and Hide tally.

clips.alt: Gavelling delegate board on a phone: Norway is 3rd in the queue, with the speakers list, roll-call status and buttons to submit a document or chat.
clips.shows: Delegate page (/delegate/CODE?country=Norway), 390x844 phone viewport at DPR 3: queue position, P / PV status, personal stats, the live speakers list and the action tiles.

clips.alt: Gavelling delegate chat on a phone: France and Ghana agree to co-sponsor a working paper in a private conversation.
clips.shows: Delegate page (/delegate/CODE?country=France), 390x844 at DPR 3, with the chat sheet open on the France-Ghana direct thread and the composer (attachments, GIF).

clips.alt: Gavelling faculty advisor view: the current speaker and upcoming queue on the left, France's delegate card open with its last motion and queue position, and nudge buttons.
clips.shows: Advisor page (/advisor/CODE), desktop 1440 wide at DPR 2, cropped to 1440x740: read-only board with now speaking, up next, an expanded delegate card with Send nudge, and the other delegates. Paper-grain overlay hidden to keep the PNG small.
